item.title: StubHub Apologizes For Promoting “Lamb Of God” Christmas Show As A Concert By The Metal Band
item.description: Some Lamb Of God fans were likely somewhat disappointed to discover that the band was in fact not performing in Spartanburg, South Carolina last week. The confusion was at the hands of StubHub, who've apologized for erroneously promoting a Christian Christmas concert as a concert by the heavy metal veterans. The post StubHub Apologizes For Promoting “Lamb Of God” Christmas Show As A Concert By The Metal Band appeared first on Stereogum.

item.title: UK Police Drop Probe Into Bob Vylan Over “Death To The IDF” Chant
item.description: It's a good day to be Bob Vylan. Months after the British rap-punk duo faced a swarm of backlash for leading their Glastonbury crowd in a "death to the IDF" chant back in June, UK police have announced that they're ending their criminal investigation against them and "no further action" will be taken.
